name: Crop and export an image
short_description: Crop an image to a stated aspect ratio and export it below a specified file size.
self_assessment: I can crop one image to a stated ratio and export it under one size limit without help.
description: Crop an image to a stated aspect ratio and export it below a specified file size. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Export a square image below a size limit
